description: Phase 2D DEVELOPMENT-ONLY probes. Not a sealed evaluation set: these queries may be used during development to check the KB-003, KB-006 and KB-007 changes. They were chosen to cover the problem classes found in the V3 failure analysis without copying any V3 query. Fingerprinted (SHA-256) before any Phase 2D implementation. Fields: expected_top = the top source must be one of these entries (null = no in-KB entry is correct); forbidden_top = the top source must NOT be any of these; allowed_status = acceptable assistant statuses; expect_risk_warning = true/false, or null when either is acceptable.

probes.query: EAI_AGAIN when the worker calls the bank API
curl: (6) Could not resolve host: acquirer.example
probes.notes: curl DNS failure message with a hostname.
Java DNS exception; the service name 'settlement' must not pull the settlement-job entry.

probes.query: Temporary failure in name resolution in container logs
deadlock detected on the ledger table
Lock wait timeout exceeded; try restarting transaction
probes.notes: MySQL error text. It is a reported error, not a request to restart anything, so ideally no risk warning; the word 'timeout' must not win over the lock meaning.

probes.query: queries stuck waiting on a row lock
probes.notes: Row-lock contention; 'stuck' must not pull the stuck-payment entry.

probes.query: whole availability zone is down for checkout
probes.notes: Zone-wide outage described as a symptom.

probes.query: primary region outage, is DR failover needed?
probes.notes: Region outage plus a question about a disruptive action (failover): a risk warning is appropriate.

probes.query: merchant account locked after failed logins
probes.notes: Account lockout is an authentication matter (KB-004 or not covered); adding lock wording to KB-003 must not capture it.
Out of KB scope and a completed event: must never be answered confidently, even after failover wording is added to KB-006.

probes.query: traffic spike during the sale is slowing checkout
probes.notes: Latency under load; regional-outage or traffic wording in KB-006 must not capture it.

probes.query: 404 not found on the refunds route
probes.notes: HTTP 404 is not covered by the KB: the Phase 2C uncovered-code rule must keep it from being answered confidently.
